"'''The Battle for Endor'''" is a short story published in ''[[The Original Trilogy Stories]]''. It was written by [[Rebecca L. Schmidt]].<ref name="Original" /> It adapts the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] during the [[Battle of Endor]].

{{Shortstory-stub}}

==Plot summary==
{{Plot-link|Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi}}

==Continuity==
"The Battle for Endor" uses a picture of [[Wicket Wystri Warrick|Wicket]] to depict [[Paploo]].
